title: Rocket Five Four Three | Tara Zooms to the Sky Kids Song | Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Join Tara on a cardboard rocket adventure up past the fluffy clouds!
This fun counting song teaches numbers from five down to one and the joy of sharing a journey with family.
Sing along and count the birds together!

Beep, beep, beep, the little window blinks
Hello, hello, Tara's here!
Five, four, three, two, one
Hold on tight, hold on tight, here we go
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, Tara zooms and zooms away
Up into the sky!
Past the fluffy clouds we fly so high
Puffy white and soft and fluffy
Zoom, zoom, zoom, the sun is peeking in
"Good morning, good morning!" the sun waves hello!
Big brother, little sis, hold my hand
Let's count all the birds that fly along with us
One, two, three, four, five birds
Tweety tweety, tweety tweety, hooray!
Down, down we go, the fins are tilting
Gently, gently, gently down to the grass
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, we land
Cheer, cheer, cheer, the garden's ours!
